description: This file defines the WorkflowStateMachineDecorator class, which acts as a wrapper or decorator for the WorkflowStateMachine object, adding additional behavior or interface. It provides methods to access the underlying workflow state machine and retrieve roles to notify related to workflow states.

classes.name: WorkflowStateMachineDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the WorkflowStateMachine entity, providing additional methods and abstraction over the underlying entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a WorkflowStateMachine object.

methods.name: getRolesToNotify
methods.description: Retrieves the roles to notify from the workflow state machine and returns them as an array, or null if none are set.
